newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll sees profits at New Jersey Steel.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll sees profits at New Jersey Steel.

text.p: Swiss engineering company Von Roll AG said it expected it loss-making New Jersey Steel Corp. (NJSCO) to return to profitability by the middle of this year.
Von Roll said it still intended to divest NJSCO in the next six to 12 months.
"We are convinced that NJSCO will be profitable again by the middle of this year," chairman Max Amstutz said in speech prepared for a news conference.
"It's is our continued goal to divest NJSCO in the next six to 12 months," Amstutz added.
Amstutz said NJSCO incurred a record loss in 1996. Von Roll's slide presentation for the news conference put the operating loss at 14 million Swiss francs.
But he said the loss was a management mistake and since then management had been replaced.

He said NJSCO had been technically modernised and expanded in the past three years and was market leader in the concrete steel sector in the North Eastern United States, a market that he said was in good shape.
